sentences.text: "Heard learned counsel the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present bail application under Section 438 Cr.PC. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in case crime/FIR No. 20/2024, under Sections 419/420/467/468/471 I.P.C., P.S. Nigohan, District Lucknow.

In the prosecution case, it is alleged that the land in question has been sold by the accused persons by hatching conspiracy to M/s Brijgopi Developers Pvt. Limited operated by Anuj Singh Rajawat (co-accused).
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The applicant is marginal witness of the sale deed.
There is no material with the prosecution to shows that the applicant has received any consideration amount.
The applicant has not received any notice during course of the investigation.
The signatures of Sarika Gupta, copy of FSL report and the sale deed are in possession of the investigating officer.
The applicant is not required for custodial interrogation.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is not a previous convict and he undertakes to cooperate in the investigation.
Issue notice to respondent No. 2.
Steps be taken within a week.
Learned Addl. Government Advocate prays for and is allowed 15 days' time to file counter affidavit.

On due consideration to the fact that the offences are triable by magistrate; he is only the marginal witness of the sale deed; the applicant is not a previous convict and also considering the judgment in Sushila Aggarwal and others versus State (NCT of Delhi) and another (2020)5 SCC 1 and without entering into the merit of the case, as an interim measure, it would be appropriate to grant interim protection to the applicant under Section 438 Cr.P.C.
Till the next date of listing, it is provided that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting officer/I.O./S.H.O. concerned.

Order Date :- 22.8.2024 Application (I.A. No.3/2024)
This is an application for correction in the order dated 22.08.2024 passed by this Court.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that due to typographical error in the order dated 22.08.2024 following paragraphs have been wrongly typed and,
therefore, they may be deleted:-
"Issue notice to respondent No.2. Steps be taken within a week."
Considering the affidavit filed in support of application as also the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicant, the application is allowed and the following paragraphs shall be treated to be deleted- "Issue notice to respondent No.2.
Steps be taken within a week."
This order shall be jointly read with order dated 22.08.2024 (supra).
Office is directed to issue a certified copy of the order accordingly.
Order Date :- 31.8.2024 "
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that against the co-accused persons,
charge-sheet has been filed
. Notice under Section 41 Cr.P.C. has not been served to the applicant.
Investigation has been kept pending against the applicant.
The applicant undertakes to cooperate with the investigation.

Considering the fact that the applicant is alleged to be marginal witness and prima facie he is not the beneficiary, the interim protection granted vide order dated 22.8.2024 is made absolute in view of dictum of Apex Court in re: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98.
